Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi:
One of the biggest mistakes the Americans have made is that they do not understand the Islamic Republic of Iran, the Iranian people, Iranian officials or the system governing Iran.
They imagine that there are divisions between individuals. That is certainly a mistaken assumption.
I can tell you, as someone who attends private meetings, that there is a consensus among all of us: the government, parliament, the Supreme National Security Council and the armed forces.
Yes, we discuss matters among ourselves during meetings, but once we reach a decision, we all stand behind a single decision and work to implement it.
From our perspective, our chief negotiator remains Dr. Ghalibaf, and he has the full support of Mr. Mohsen Rezaei.

Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi:
If Mr. Vance sent a message to Mr. Rezaei, he should be asked why.
If their intention was to create divisions, that would be another mistake added to their long series of mistakes.
